description: Deterministic activation-contract fixtures for Buildable skills. Positive, indirect, incomplete, negative, and edge prompts keep the four skills useful without activating them for unrelated work.

cases.prompt: Use $buildable-planner to plan a local-first CRM for a small sales team.

I want to build a habit tracker but I do not know whether it should be web or mobile.
Turn this product idea into an archetype and phased prototype plan: a volunteer shift scheduler.
Build me a local-first app for tracking subscriptions.
Use $buildable-web-builder to implement the saved app spec.
Buildable Web Builder: generate the selected CRM starter.
The Buildable plan is approved. Implement it as a local-first Next.js prototype.
Adapt this Buildable web app spec into a responsive dashboard prototype.
Generate the web prototype from .buildable/phase-plan.json.
Use $buildable-mobile-builder to implement this Expo app spec.
Buildable Mobile Builder: generate the selected habit-tracker starter.
The Buildable plan is approved. Build the local-first React Native prototype.

Use $buildable-reviewer to audit this prototype against its app spec.
Buildable Reviewer: check state coverage, accessibility, and responsiveness.
Review the generated Buildable app against the local-first quality rubric.
